+import os

+import base64
+import requests
+
+
+def load_identity_config(overrides=None):
+    overrides = overrides or {}
+    config = {
+        "provider_id": overrides.get("provider_id") or os.getenv("GOOGLE_PROVIDER_ID", "google.com"),
+        "api_key": overrides.get("api_key") or os.environ["GOOGLE_API_KEY"],
+        "client_id": overrides.get("client_id") or os.getenv("GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID"),

+        "redirect_uri": overrides.get("redirect_uri") or os.getenv("GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI"),
+    }
+    return {k: v for k, v in config.items() if v is not None}
+
+
+def oauth_session():
+    return requests.Session()
+
+
+def pkce_pair():
+    verifier = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(32)).rstrip(b"=").decode("ascii")
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode("ascii")).digest()
+    challenge = base64.urlsafe_b64encode(digest).rstrip(b"=").decode("ascii")
+    return verifier, challenge

+        "client_secret": config["client_secret"],
+        "redirect_uri": payload["redirect_uri"],

+        id_token=token.get("id_token"),
+        refresh_token=token.get("refresh_token"),
+        token_type=token.get("token_type"),
+        expires_in=token.get("expires_in"),
+    )
+    return bundle.__dict__
+

+import requests
+from identity_client import pkce_pair, load_identity_config
+
+
+def pkce_login(payload, config=None):
+    config = load_identity_config(config)
+    verifier, challenge = pkce_pair()
+    request = {
+        "providerId": config["provider_id"],
+        "continueUri": payload["redirect_uri"],
+        "codeChallenge": challenge,
+        "codeChallengeMethod": "S256",
+    }
+    if config.get("tenant_id"):
+        request["tenantId"] = config["tenant_id"]
+    response = requests.post(
+        "https://identitytoolkit.googleapis.com/v1/accounts:createAuthUri",
+        params={"key": config["api_key"]},
+        json=request,
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    result = response.json()
+    result["code_verifier"] = verifier
+    result["authorization_url"] = result.get("authUri")
+    return result
+
*** End Patch
